item.tib: dkar mo tshe yi bsgrub pa'i dbu phyogs pa'i dbu phyogs
item.coloph: dkar mo tshe yis bsgrab (yi sgrub) pa a ya/ las mtha' tshe'i yig chung / mi rul rtsi dang ser nas bslug lcags 'phrang brag la zab rgya gdab/ phyi rabs nyi zer bzhin du dar rgyas shog ('di'i bar zhang zhung smar chung 'dug)sprul sku/ dpon gsas bla ma'i brgyud pa/ atham/ rdzogs/ dge'o//
